shared_elements: horizontal band or register with repeated motifs across upper part of the surface
row of repeated curved/hook-like elements in a band
zigzag or triangular band bordering a register
paired/repeated elements aligned in a row
framed panel set on a large upright slab with rounded top
justification: Both show an upright slab bearing a horizontally banded panel in which a row of repeated curved, hook-shaped forms runs above/below a border of triangles or zigzag chevrons, and both include profile animal-like figures with rows of repeated units. However, A depicts identifiable creatures (quadrupeds, a large bird with a long neck, human-like figures, a serpent-like form) filling the whole shaft in a narrative-like stacked composition, whereas B is confined to an abstract, purely ornamental panel of repeated hooks and geometric bands with no recognisable creature or figure.
